meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你选的 NanoClaw 群组里搭一个长期 wiki:建好 wiki/、sources/ 文件夹和 index.md、log.md,写入一套维护规则。之后你发来资料,它会一个一个地消化并更新 wiki 页面,而不是囫囵吞枣。
howto.when: 当你说出“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等触发词时触发。技能会先询问要加到哪个群组,然后开始搭建。

say.text: 我想在这个群里加一个持久 wiki 知识库。
say.note: 开始建 wiki 流程,先问用哪个群组。

say.text: 用 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式给我们建个知识库。
say.note: 读取模式文件并和你讨论内容设计。

say.text: 把我们的资料整理成 wiki 吧,按 Karpathy wiki 那套来。
say.note: 带你选群组并创建目录、写入规则。

howto.what_en: On install, Claude sets up a persistent wiki in a NanoClaw group you pick: creates wiki/ and sources/ folders, index.md/log.md, and adds maintenance rules. Files/URLs you send later get processed one by one to update wiki pages, not skimmed.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "add wiki", "wiki", or "knowledge base". It first asks which group to use, then starts setting up.

say_en.text: I want a persistent wiki knowledge base for this group.
say_en.note: Starts the wiki-setup flow and asks which group to use.

say_en.text: Set up a knowledge base using Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
say_en.note: Reads the pattern file, then asks you to design the wiki.

say_en.text: Let's organize our files into a wiki based on Karpathy wiki.
say_en.note: Guides through group selection and creates directories.
